segments.en: Let's see how AI agents are actually built. If you want to build AI agents,
Both people who know coding and people who don't can build AI agents.
Those who know coding use languages like Python with advanced frameworks
In these agents, multiple agents can work together,
integrating with APIs and different apps - there are advanced capabilities like these.
Such AI agents, not just for simple automation,
for large projects, business automation systems, internal workflows - professional-level use cases - they are used.
people who don't know coding are also creating simple AI agents using no-code tools.
Make - with tools like these you can create drag-and-drop workflows.
You select predefined actions, like replying to emails, sending WhatsApp messages,
generating reports, running basic automations - routine tasks.
No coding is needed. So even without technical knowledge, building and using basic AI agents is something many people are doing now.
